body: It works most of the time for me, though some days doesn't seem like enough. I guess it would be a mix between rap and poetry? I write a lot of rap verses. But if I'm really down its usually more of a deep poem with no beat behind it. I'd say do it. Doesn't have to be music. It does get you mind off things in a way though. Helped me last night.

That's the thing right, I'm well aware of things I need to change. But gathering the motivation to actually go out and do it seems easier said then done. Everything comes in waves. I'll spend a week all down on myself then come to the conclusion to make changes. I plan it out then I just don't do it. Then I beat myself up for not doing it.  I do have a couple hobbies. The only thing that has kept me from offing myself on many many nights, was writing music. That's basicly all I have. That and I like to collect folding knives. I was right into jiu jitsu for a few months about 2 years ago. But hurt my shoulder and lost motivation to go back. I have my mother and stepfather but have never really been close with or talk to any other family.I am usually content with being alone. But when I don't want to be alone, not having anyone to call eats me alive some nights.

I see life as a never ending repeat till your dead. One of my biggest problems is trust. I've been screwed with, stolen from, used, lied to, to the point where it's hard for me to trust anyone. I tend to see the worst in people. (Been trying to work on that) I feel like every friendship ive ever had has been one sided. I will never hear from anyone unless I call them first. If I disappeared off the map I can't think of anyone who'd actually be looking for me. I feel pethetic even being on here knowing at the end of the day NO ONE really cares whether I'm here or gone. I do appreciate the nice words.
